name: 4-coil Shakti: amygdala left + hippocampus right, synchronized (30 min)
summary: Murphy's stereo Shakti session in its 'synchronized' form: the amygdala signal on the left temporal lobe and the hippocampal signal on the right play at the same time. Murphy presents it as positive emotion (left amygdala) plus positive cognition (right hippocampus). Both signals are rebuilt from descriptions; the vendor's files are not published.
setting: Evenings: the vendor says sessions are 'usually better after the sun goes down'. Darkness and quiet (the vendor says effects during a session need darkness and silence); eyes closed, relaxed, without meditating or falling asleep; no meditation, mind machines or drugs at the same time.
schedule: Vendor's Shakti rules: at most every 72 h or once a week, never on consecutive days; a series of 3 or 6 sessions, then a 21-day break.
notes: The vendor's page 'Amygdala (left) and hippocampus (right) signals' describes this stereo session. Tsang 2004 describes the Shakti's right-side signal as 'one pulse followed 170 ms later by four high frequency pulses about 3.8 times per sec', 'delivered once every 4.76 s', with the burst-firing pattern 'simultaneously' on the left (p.5 [1017]). Played here: both signals start together every 4.76 s. The amygdala burst is the project's rising sweep, 6 to 30 Hz, at the lab's burst length of 230 points (Ryczko 2002 p.1 [592], p.2 [593]) of 3 ms, 0.69 s. The hippocampal signal is the primed burst: one pulse, then four pulses 170 ms later, three times in 0.74 s (after Tsang 2004 p.5 [1017]). Both are rebuilt from descriptions: the vendor's files are not published. Coils: FT7 and TP7 on the left, FT8 and TP8 on the right, each pair one (+) and one (-) coil, as in every Shakti unit. The sites are the project's reading: the vendor's 4-coil photo shows one coil above the other. Field strength: Tsang 2004 gives about 1 uT near the scalp on the left and 0.5 uT on the right (p.5-6 [1017-1018]). This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. At 1 uT that is about 24 uT at the scalp on both sides, 24 and 48 times Tsang's figures. Support: the vendor's reports and its reading of small lab studies. Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). Other forms: murphy-shakti-amyl-hippr-variants-sequence and murphy-shakti-amyl-hippr-variants-slow. One negative report followed sessions longer than suggested: keep to 30 min. Murphy reports headache or pressure in about 2% of users of an earlier version, mostly with hippocampal signals; if so, lower the intensity by one third. Not for people with epilepsy; stop at once if distressed.
